Report:Pointage - Synth\u00e8se p\u00e9r.name: Pointage - Synthèse période
Report:Pointage - Synth\u00e8se p\u00e9r.query:
select
  l.nom_ouvrier as "Ouvrier",
  l.metier as "Métier",
  p.projet as "Chantier",
  l.devise as "Devise",
  round(sum(l.heures), 2) as "Heures",
  round(sum(l.heures / coalesce(nullif(l.heures_reference, 0), 8)), 2) as "Jours équiv.",
  round(sum(l.montant), 3) as "Montant"
from `tabPointage Ligne` l
join `tabPointage Journalier` p on l.parent = p.name
where p.statut_validation = 'Validé'
  and p.date between %(from_date)s and %(to_date)s
group by l.ouvrier, l.nom_ouvrier, l.metier, p.projet, l.devise
order by l.metier, l.nom_ouvrier

Report:Pointage vs Caisse MO.name: Pointage vs Caisse MO
Report:Pointage vs Caisse MO.query:
select
  dev as "Devise",
  round(sum(pointage), 3) as "Pointage validé",
  round(sum(avance), 3) as "Caisse — Avances MO",
  round(sum(paie), 3) as "Caisse — Paies MO",
  round(sum(pointage) - sum(avance) - sum(paie), 3) as "Écart"
from (
  select p.devise as dev, p.total_montant as pointage, 0 as avance, 0 as paie
  from `tabPointage Journalier` p
  where p.statut_validation = 'Validé'
    and p.date between %(from_date)s and %(to_date)s
  union all
  select m.devise,
         0,
         case when m.categorie = 'Main d''œuvre — Avance' then m.montant else 0 end,
         case when m.categorie = 'Main d''œuvre — Paie' then m.montant else 0 end
  from `tabMouvement Caisse` m
  where m.type_mouvement = 'Dépense'
    and coalesce(m.statut_validation, '') = 'Validé'
    and m.categorie in ('Main d''œuvre — Avance', 'Main d''œuvre — Paie')
    and m.date between %(from_date)s and %(to_date)s
) x
group by dev
